contentPattern.structure: icon banner image + title + download/access CTA link (whole card is a link)

suitableFor: media kit / press resource download grids (fact sheets, product cards, photo galleries)
repeating item cards where each card is an icon banner + title + a download or access CTA
document/asset link tiles with a bordered card treatment
notSuitableFor: news / article teaser grids with photos, dates and read-more (use cards-news)
milestone / timeline grids with year labels (use cards-milestone)
